x-m-e6-07.title: Domin a kiyaye ɗanɗanon madarar strawberry lokacin yin ƙari

x-m-e6-07.thinking.1: Duba ko ƙimomin rabon sun yi daidai
x-m-e6-07.prereq.1: Lissafi ta hanyar ninka lambobi biyu
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya zo, zaɓi abin da kuke tunani.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, rubuta rabon strawberry da madara iri ɗaya, sannan ku kwatanta.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bambanta matakin da kuka yi tunanin “sau nawa ne” da matakin da kuka yi tunanin “kofuna nawa suka fi”.

x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.after: 3:2 yana nufin strawberry ya ninka madara sau 1.5, 6:5 kuma yana nufin sau 1.2, saboda haka rabon ya canza. Ƙara adadi iri ɗaya ba lallai ya kiyaye rabon ba.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Wataƙila haɗuwa ce kawai, don haka ku sake gwada wannan hanya sau ɗaya
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Idan sakamako ya yi baƙon abu, za ku iya fara duba hanyar da kanta kafin ku ɗora wa sa’a laifi.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Duba ko rabon strawberry da madara, 3:2, ya canza zuwa 6:5
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kun yi amfani da sakamakon a matsayin alama don duba hanyar.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Sakamakon ya riga ya fi karkata ga madara, don haka ƙara madara zai ƙara nisanta shi.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Ta ninka strawberry (kofuna 6) da madara (kofuna 4) sau biyu, kuma ɗanɗanon ya yi daidai da na farko.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Domin samun ɗanɗano iri ɗaya da kofuna 9 na strawberry, kofuna nawa na madara ake buƙata?
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Kofunan strawberry 3 sun zama 9, wato sau 3, don haka dole ne kofunan madara 2 ma su ninka sau 3 su zama 6. 3:2 = 9:6.

x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Strawberry ya ƙaru da kofuna 6, don haka kun ƙara madara da kofuna 6. Kun sake amfani da tunanin farko, “ƙara adadi iri ɗaya.”
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kun yi hasashe da lamba tsakanin yawan strawberry da madara. Ba ku duba ko 3:2 ya kasance ba.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.info: A wannan karon tana son amfani da kofuna 4.5 na strawberry. Tana kiran adadin madara kofuna □, sannan ta kafa rabo daidai 3 : 2 = 4.5 : □.

x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kun musanya kalmomin waje da na ciki yayin ninkawa. Sake duba lambobin da aka haɗa a ninkawar rabo daidai.

x-m-e6-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bayyana da kalmominku sau nawa kuka ƙara yawan strawberry.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ku ba da misali mai lamba bisa hanyar da kuka yi amfani da ita.

x-m-e6-07.s.s2.model.0: Idan kun ninka strawberry sau biyu, dole ne ku ninka madara sau biyu ma. Kamar 3:2 → 6:4.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.model.1: Kada a ƙara; a ninka domin kiyaye rabon iri ɗaya. Idan strawberry kofuna 9 ne, madara kofuna 6 ce.

x-m-e6-03.material: A wani shagon ruwan 'ya'yan itace, an haɗa ruwan kauri da ruwa da kofi iri ɗaya. Hajun ya ce, 'B yana da ruwan kauri da yawa, kofi 4, saboda haka B ya fi ƙarfi!' (A nan, 'ƙarfi' yana nufin idan ka sha adadi ɗaya, akwai ruwan kauri da yawa a cikinsa.)

x-m-e6-03.thinking.2: Nemo kuma ka bayyana ma'aunin kwatantawa (abin gaba ɗaya)

x-m-e6-03.prereq.1: Kwatanta girman kaso masu lambobi gaba ɗaya masu lambobi ɗaya da biyu

x-m-e6-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka zaɓi ma'aunin da ke kallon ruwan kauri da jimillar adadin tare.
